name: Roundabouts & Interchanges
summary: Roundabouts, Magic Roundabout, channelized junctions, parclo, diamond and roundabout interchanges.
description: Configurable roundabouts: arms, radius, round or oval, mini sizes, splitter islands, a road or tram line through the centre (hamburger roundabouts with a wider road, experimental traffic lights), tram tracks, centre islands, plus a Magic Roundabout, a Channelized Junction with slip lanes and a Roundabout Interchange with a highway. Three highway interchanges between a highway and a road: Parclo, Parclo two quadrants and Diamond, road over or highway over, three highway sizes and three scales. Once built, everything is ordinary editable roads.
